answer: Require each agent’s messages to be backed by a stake locked in a shared contract, and slash that stake when independent auditors prove the agent double-voted in the same round. One person can still create many identities, but each must lock real capital, while detected coordination burns it; spreading names no longer makes votes cheap. A ferrous key, crystal ledger, or grove of aliases changes nothing: the attacker pays per identity and risks losing the stake. The mechanism raises the cost of Sybils rather than claiming to make them impossible.
